description: For a finite atom set \(S\) and a valuation \(v\), the signed context contains each atom of \(S\) that \(v\) makes true and the negation of each atom of \(S\) that \(v\) makes false.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.signedContext.{u_1} {α : Type u_1} [DecidableEq α] (S : Finset α) (v : α → Bool) :
  Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.PropFormula α)
